headline: Volume and pricing lift earnings sharply
summary_short: CF Industries' Q3 net sales of $1,860M rose 12% y/y and diluted EPS of $2.87 rose 31%. Adjusted EBITDA reached $833M, up from $667M.
summary_long: Adjusted EBITDA rose on strong volume, higher pricing and lower realized gas cost. Realized natural gas cost was $2.87 per MMBtu versus $2.96 a year earlier. Net earnings were reduced by higher net interest expense of $76M versus $18M. Trailing-twelve-month free cash flow was about $2.0B and $1.3B was returned to shareholders over that period; $1.1B remains on the current repurchase authorization. Yazoo City is expected to resume operations in 1H 2027. The deck gives no formal numeric guidance.
confidence_notes: Source is the earnings presentation filed as Exhibit 99.1, not a text press release. Adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow are company-defined non-GAAP measures. Y/y deltas are computed from the reported dollar values. The shard's Yahoo EPS of 2.87 matches the deck's diluted EPS.

drivers.explanation: Q3 adjusted EBITDA was favorable, driven by strong volume, pricing and lower realized gas cost.
Net earnings to common rose 23.5% while diluted shares fell to 151.6M from 161.2M, lifting per-share growth above earnings growth.
